author: Astra, during the interactive implementation session
status: Exploratory follow-up selected using development outcomes
observed_problem: The stronger coding edit on training context 0 improved correct development functions from 3/4 to 4/4 while retained functions fell from 4/4 to 3/4.
observed_recovery_probe: Four fixed rehearsal updates restored retained development functions to 4/4 and preserved 4/4 coding functions in that one context.
prediction_for_next_run: Rewarding the complete edit-and-recovery sequence may let an editor select useful adaptations that the pre-recovery reward rejected. Compare against both no edit and recovery alone, and do not assume this transfers to other contexts.
